experience.description: Implemented device deletion through an existing REST API in TypeScript, mapping responses to application models and handling invalid IDs, missing devices, and service failures; passed GitLab/Jenkins CI checks. Redesigned Kotlin validation to link errors to conflicting device settings and corrected device-to-network lookups; added unit tests and updated browser end-to-end tests to verify both changes. Took ownership of a senior developer’s in-progress performance optimization, rebased the branch and resolved merge conflicts, and delivered the work 4 days ahead of schedule.

experience.description: Built a Python/XGBoost pipeline to predict depression from wearable and smartphone data in a 26-participant, 90-day study; achieved 0.74 AUC at baseline using leave-one-subject-out cross-validation.
